_comment: Constellos plugin - Claude Code session harness (spec: constellos/constellos docs/specs/2026-09-03-agent-harness-and-eval-unification.md, D5/section 7)
_notes: SessionStart mints or resumes a Constellos thread and persists CONSTELLOS_THREAD/CONSTELLOS_SPACE
UserPromptSubmit records the user turn and injects the addressed objective's residual and beliefs
Stop records the assistant reply as an assistant turn (skipped while the server lacks role support)
PostToolUse reminds about doc/spec updates when watched source paths are edited
All network hooks are best-effort: no CLI, no token, or no network never blocks the session
Transport is the constellos CLI against the bare origin (never .../mcp - token dir is keyed by the bare URL)
Timeouts are >= 10s because the CLI performs a tools/list round trip before every tools/call

hooks.description: Mints or resumes the session's Constellos thread and persists it for later hooks
Records the prompt as a user turn and injects objective residual/beliefs as context
Records the assistant reply as an assistant turn on the session's thread
Reminds about doc/spec updates when watched source paths change without one
